name: insert-select
catalog: CREATE TABLE a (c1 INT, c2 INT); CREATE TABLE t (c1 INT, c2 INT);
script: INSERT INTO t(c1, c2) SELECT c1, c2 FROM a;

name: update-join
catalog: CREATE TABLE a (c1 INT, c2 INT); CREATE TABLE b (c1 INT, c3 INT);
script: UPDATE a JOIN b ON a.c1 = b.c1 SET a.c2 = b.c3;

name: merge-upsert
catalog: CREATE TABLE s (c1 INT, c2 INT); CREATE TABLE t (c1 INT, c2 INT);
script: MERGE INTO t USING s ON t.c1 = s.c1 WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.c2 = s.c2 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (c1, c2) VALUES (s.c1, s.c2);

name: delete-and-truncate
catalog: CREATE TABLE t (c1 INT); CREATE TABLE s (c1 INT);
script: DELETE FROM t WHERE c1 IN (SELECT c1 FROM s); TRUNCATE TABLE t;

name: session-use
catalog: CREATE TABLE db1.a (c1 INT); CREATE TABLE db2.a (c2 INT);
script: USE db1; SELECT c1 FROM a; USE db2; SELECT c2 FROM a;
